name: Oslo Metropolitan University
summary: University in Oslo and at Kjeller; its 42 bachelor's, in health, teaching, engineering, design and more, are taught in Norwegian.

ib.text: Study in Norwegian if you have Danish, Swedish or Norwegian A (SL or HL), or Norwegian B HL, at grade 3 or better: that documents Norwegian, and you apply through Samordna opptak.

notes: OsloMet's English course search shows one "Bachelor's degree", but it is a 7.5-credit course (ØAADM3820), not a degree programme.
17 of the 42 list Norwegian and English as teaching languages, but they still require general entry, which includes Norwegian.
Samordna opptak's deadline has been 15 April; its 2027 calendar is not yet published.
